summary: Iteration 5 backend-only testing. Validated the infra/startup changes: run_redis.py self-healing, event_worker.py startup retry, supervisor hardening, restore_runtime.py, and WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET migration to backend/.env for the platform cron dispatcher. All 14 iteration-5 targeted tests pass, existing 74/74 backend_test.py regression passes, and 17/17 fetch-metadata auth suite passes. All services left RUNNING.
critical_code_review_comments: backend_test.py Maintenance Endpoint test comment says 'secret in .env.local' but the secret is now in backend/.env after the fix. Comment should be updated for accuracy (non-blocking).

test_iteration5_resilience.py originally used httpx cookies.get() which raised CookieConflict because both root path and /api path cookies are set. Fixed by reading from response cookies.jar. Consider tightening backend Set-Cookie Path handling to avoid duplicate cookies, though this is cosmetic and does not affect browser or curl behavior.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md — Demo@2026! for all demo accounts.
seed_data_creation: None. Test-created applications persisted normally; no cleanup requested.
verified_scenarios: supervisorctl all RUNNING (backend, samanvay-redis, samanvay-events); redis-cli PONG; API root 200; /monitoring/overview shows redis+consumer HEALTHY
Login 200 for operator@demo.in and citizen@demo.in with samanvay_session + samanvay_csrf; wrong password -> 401 (not 503)
Citizen e2e: POST /api/applications -> 201; within ~10s COMPLETED with all 4 stages COMPLETED; operator payment-evidence shows exactly 1 disbursement

Redis outage: stopped samanvay-redis; samanvay-events remained RUNNING (did not crash); login returned 503 during outage as designed; after restart, login 200, heartbeat key samanvay:consumer:heartbeat present, new application completes 4/4
Startup-with-redis-down: stopped both; started samanvay-events first (redis still down); worker stayed RUNNING; after redis start it proceeded and new application COMPLETED

Dispatcher: /app/.emergent/cron/dispatch_webhook.sh with correct env returned http=202 twice within same minute (idempotent); wrong bearer -> 401; maintenance_receipts contains workflow-recovery-<utc-ts> ids
setup_local.py idempotent (2 runs OK); backend/.env contains WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET, backend/.env.local does NOT; MONGO_URL and DB_NAME preserved
restore_runtime.py exits 0 and leaves all services RUNNING
Regression: /app/tests/backend_test.py 74 passed / 0 failed / 1 warning (test's own outdated comment about secret location); /app/tests/test_fetch_metadata_auth.py 17/17 passed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-5 focused suite at /app/tests/test_iteration5_resilience.py covers infra resilience (redis outage while worker running, worker startup with redis down), dispatcher (success/idempotent/wrong-bearer), health, e2e journey, setup idempotence, and restore_runtime. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL public host. Does not print WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET. Existing /app/tests/backend_test.py still passes 74/74; its 'Maintenance Endpoint' warning about the secret living in .env.local is now stale (secret moved to .env). All services confirmed RUNNING at end of run.
